fillAssumptions.bars: Alpaca SIP one-minute bars, raw prices, regular session plus the closing print
fillAssumptions.entry: rebound confirmed at a completed minute close; buy at the first observed trade at or after the decision (next minute open, the closing print only for a decision before the close, else the next session open)
fillAssumptions.stop: trailing stop level from the post-entry high (updated once a day, never lowered), active only while a fill at the level nets a profit after interest; a session opening at or below it fills at the opening trade; intraday, 'stop' fills at the level when the minute opened above it, at the minute's open when it opened through it; 'next-open' fills at the next observed trade
fillAssumptions.maximumHold: from the hold day, a position whose sale at the opening trade would lose money sells at the next observed trade
fillAssumptions.bufferedLoss: from the hold day, the first completed minute closing at or below the buffer sells at the next observed trade
fillAssumptions.interest: simple interest at the annual rate per calendar day from the entry session date, none on the entry date
fillAssumptions.costs: none unless the run labels a per-side cost; a per-side cost worsens every fill and is counted in every net-profit test
fillAssumptions.drawdown: minute-sampled: the largest fall of the cumulative strategy P&L marked at every regular-session minute close and the official close; daily: marked at the official close only
